recipe.visualDefinition: A technical, grid-based composition featuring a mathematical curve defined by green tick marks and red dotted vertical lines, overlaid with a photographic inset of a ship and stylized serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Geometric grid background vs. organic photographic inset
Linear graph elements vs. curved typographic flow
High-contrast green and red accents against a neutral gray textured field
Vertical red dotted lines connecting the curve to the baseline
coreInvariants: Green diagonal tick marks along the curve
Red dotted vertical lines with horizontal caps
Photographic inset with a glowing, semi-circular aura

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary subject is a mathematical curve rising from bottom-left to top-right, with a rectangular photographic inset positioned in the bottom-right quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The photographic inset of the ship serves as the heavy visual anchor, while the large green title provides a secondary anchor at the top-left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the curve upward from the left, is interrupted by the ship inset, and then continues to the top-right corner following the vertical text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The gray grid functions as active negative space, maintaining a technical, structured feel throughout.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Mid-gray textured background with white grid lines.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant emerald green for the main title and curve ticks.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright red for the dotted vertical data lines and secondary text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation accents (green/red) pop against a low-saturation, medium-value gray background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: High-contrast transitional serif with sharp terminals.
letterConstructionRules: Main title uses all-caps for the first word and lowercase italics for the second.
Secondary text is placed individually atop vertical data lines.
Outlined effects on the main title to separate it from the grid.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'W' has a wide, overlapping center.
The 'g' features a closed loop with a sharp ear.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A bold, outlined display serif paired with a smaller, lighter version of the same typeface family for technical annotations.

preserve: Placement of letters on vertical axes

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast serif structure and classic 80s tech feel.
Provides the sharp terminals and extreme stroke contrast seen in the display text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a textured gray background with a white square grid. Draw a mathematical curve from bottom-left to top-right using green diagonal tick marks. Add red dotted vertical lines from the curve to the bottom, each capped with a small red horizontal bar. In the bottom right, place a rectangular photo of a white ship on dark water with a glowing white semi-circular aura above it.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in the top left using a bold green serif font with a thin white outline. Place individual white serif capital letters at the top of each red vertical line to spell out secondary text following the curve.

verificationChecks: Grid is perfectly square and uniform.
Red lines are dotted, not solid.
Green title has a visible white outline.
Ship photo has a grainy, high-contrast texture.

mustRedesign: Exact wording of the original text

mustAchieve: Technical precision in the grid and graph

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the green ticks are diagonal and consistent.
Check that the red dotted lines align perfectly with the grid intersections.
Verify the glow effect on the ship inset is soft but distinct.
Confirm the serif font maintains sharp points and high contrast.
recipe.reuseFormula: Technical Grid + Mathematical Curve + Data Points + Photographic Inset + Outlined Serif Typography = 80s Data-Art Aesthetic.
